description.zh-CN: Pi 是 MIT 开源的 AI 编码智能体工具箱：统一 LLM API、智能体循环、TUI 与编码 CLI 二合一。平台包自包含（无需 Node），接任意模型即装即用。
description.en: Pi is an MIT-licensed AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding CLI in one. Platform bundles are self-contained (no Node needed) — bring any model and go.

node.supported: not required (self-contained platform bundle; npm install path additionally needs Node 22.19+ but AiBOX ships the bundle)

runtime.note: Self-contained executable per platform (win: pi.exe; mac: pi/pi) plus native prebuilds. Terminal-first tool.

packages.name: Pi coding agent (zip, win32-x64)
packages.hashSource: GitHub release asset digest (2026-11-18, upstream published sha256; mac archive also re-measured locally and matched)

channels.note: Self-contained pi.exe (verified via zip central directory)

args: $d="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Pi"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; Expand-Archive -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.aibox\cache\downloads\e6adb8cb8c84eca14391ad24b363de9d2be98a89ca3ba3fdee1fa4de32b7f2e8.zip" "$env:TEMP\aibox-pi"; Copy-Item "$env:TEMP\aibox-pi\pi.exe" "$d\pi.exe" -Force; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:TEMP\aibox-pi"
install.notes: Expand the zip and copy the self-contained pi.exe into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Pi (no Node required). Launch from any terminal.

packages.name: Pi coding agent (tar.gz, arm64)
packages.hashSource: GitHub release asset digest (2026-11-18); full 48MB tarball downloaded locally — sha256 matched upstream digest exactly and layout verified (pi/pi executable + native prebuilds)

args: set -e; M=$(mktemp -d); tar -xzf "$HOME/.aibox/cache/downloads/56b5e194d485ced555667b8ba3276157a8272e9ecde9e001e428af80985bdd9b.gz" -C "$M"; rm -rf /Applications/Pi; mkdir -p /Applications/Pi; cp -R "$M/pi/." /Applications/Pi/; chmod +x /Applications/Pi/pi; rm -rf "$M"
install.notes: Extract pi/ and copy into /Applications/Pi (executable at Pi/pi; no Node required). TODO real-machine verification (Phase 3).

openrouter.label: OpenRouter (recommended)
openrouter.note: One key for every model; configure in ~/.pi/config.json or per-session /model.

anthropic.label: Anthropic API
anthropic.note: Claude models direct from the source (pi default provider).

ollama.label: Ollama (local, free)
ollama.note: Run models on your own machine — zero API cost.

recommendedModels.name: Qwen3 Coder 30B
recommendedModels.note: 本地编码推荐（需 24GB+ 内存）

upgrade.notes: Re-extract the new release over the install folder; ~/.pi (sessions, config) survives. Built-in updater: `pi update`.

uninstall.notes: ~/.pi holds sessions and provider configuration — back up first if you want history kept.

risk.onUninstall: 会话历史与模型配置都在 ~/.pi，删除即丢失，建议先备份

tagline.zh-CN: 开源 AI 编码智能体（122k★）：终端里会读写文件、跑命令、管会话的助手
tagline.en: Open-source AI coding agent (122k★): reads, edits, runs and manages sessions in your terminal
